results.title: Aaron Judge Gives Injury Update Amid Rehab From Rib Issue as Yankees Approach MLB Playoffs
results.description: New York Yankees superstar outfielder Aaron Judge hasn't played since May 31 due to a stress fracture of his first rib on his right side. However, he took a key step toward making his return after taking on-field batting practice with the team in San Diego, where the Yankees will play a three-game series with the Padres from Friday through Sunday.
